reason: Prevent CHLOM Continuous Publisher from treating GitHub installation API quota exhaustion during gate observation as a publication failure when repository governance can enforce the exact-head merge gate and destination truth can be proven through git-object digest readback.

changes.reason: Remove quota-sensitive Actions/check-run polling from the terminal merge path, keep explicit governed-gate dispatch, enable auto-merge under the active non-bypassable main ruleset, use bounded retries only around required GitHub API mutations, and prove the final destination through exact git-object SHA-256 readback.

exclusions: No credential creation, rotation, read, or exposure.
No D3 authority, rights grant, money movement, contract acceptance, or certification.
PentaCertifier remains independent and must re-read post-merge runtime/provider/DAIL evidence before certification.
